items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Buckshot. They called him Buckshot once, because he was on a record in England where he couldn’t use his name.

ctx.x: I called him and asked. I said, “What do I need to ask Jimmy Cobb?” He said, “Ask him about the Bullet.” It took me a while to understand: Cannonball, Bullet, Cannonball, Bullet.

Yeah, Buckshot. They called him Buckshot once, because he was on a record in England where he couldn’t use his name. He wasn’t supposed to be recording for anybody else. So he has – his name was Buckshot La Funke.
So that’s where Branford [Marsalis] got that from.
